01 / About

Practical systems, built around the work people actually do.

I’m an AI Automation Developer focused on turning real business workflows into structured, reliable systems. I start with the process: where information arrives, where people repeat the same actions, and where errors can creep in.

My background in Pharmacy adds a useful lens to this work—especially in systems where accuracy, batch handling, and clear operational records matter. It informs the way I think about process design without changing my focus: building useful automation.

02 / Opportunity mapping

What does automation actually do?

A business receives information. Instead of an employee manually performing every predictable step, a defined workflow can collect the data, apply logic, update the right systems, and notify the right people.
